profile_text.body:
Fireflies.ai is a Miami, Florida-based company that offers an AI meeting assistant it describes as the "#1 AI Teammate for Meetings, Email, Chat & CRM." According to its own site, the product takes notes, manages tasks, and automates workflows across meetings, email, chat, CRM, and other connected applications, with the goal of building a searchable knowledge base of a team's work in one place.

The core product, accessible via the email address fred@fireflies.ai, can be invited to live meetings or set to autojoin calendar meetings in order to record, transcribe, and summarize them. The company also offers a feature set it calls AI Skills, which it describes as tools to automatically extract key details, generate follow-up emails, score candidates, and surface other insights from meeting content.

The site's held facts categorize Fireflies.ai under Notes, Knowledge, and Meetings and flag that consent considerations are relevant to its meeting transcription function, which is consistent with the broader legal landscape around call recording. The company carries a Florida law-exposure indicator with a count of 47, which may reflect regulatory or litigation surface area in that state, though no specific cases are recorded.
